verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, a hardware accelerator card. Subscribing to events through registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is a SaaS/service axis that does not fit this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the card or its first-party stack (CUDA, SDKs, NIM) shipping webhook subscriptions that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
